title: Pushlings
summary: Pushlings is a competitive multiplayer game where players compete to accumulate the highest number of points through movement. Each step counts toward the score, while enemies appear throughout the match and other players compete for space by pushing each other.
about:
WELCOME TO THE SHOW!

Pushlings is a chaotic competitive multiplayer game where a well-timed shove can turn the round around. Step into a game-show arena and compete across a variety of modes, battling for space, chasing points, and pushing rivals out of your way. Every mode brings a different challenge, but one thing stays the same:  watch your back.

CLASSIC — EVERY STEP COUNTS

Keep moving, rack up steps, and shove rivals off their rhythm. With enemies closing in and opponents blocking your path, finding room to run is part of the challenge. Finish with the most steps when time runs out to take the win.

FOOTBALL — PUSH FOR THE GOAL

Take to the pitch and push the ball into the opposing team’s goal. Clear a path, disrupt your rivals, and turn a scramble for possession into a scoring opportunity. The team with the most goals wins.

BOX RACING — COLLECT. DEFEND. DISRUPT.

Boxes are falling from the sky, and everyone wants a bigger pile. Drag them into your designated area, then protect your collection while pushing boxes out of your rivals’ zones. Only the boxes inside each area when time runs out count—so don’t celebrate too early.

SUMO — MAKE YOURSELF AT HOME

There’s a scoring zone in the middle, and everyone wants your spot. Stay inside to earn points while shoving opponents out to stop them earning theirs. With no falls to interrupt the action, it’s a constant fight for space. Most points wins.

LAST STANDING — HOLD YOUR GROUND

Battle for the central scoring zone on a map of towers, where every fall costs precious time. Stay in the zone to earn points and send opponents off the edge to leave them waiting to respawn. Victory goes to the player with the most points.

GREEN LIGHT, RED LIGHT — THE FINISH IS JUST THE START

Move on green. Freeze on red. Get caught moving and you’re back at the start. Reach the finish zone to begin earning points, then fight to stay there as rivals arrive and try to push you out. Getting there first gives you a head start—but the highest score takes the win.

A LITTLE POWER GOES A LONG WAY

Grab temporary power-ups across most game modes to gain an edge when it matters. Whether you’re chasing points or protecting your position, the right opportunity can turn a close contest in your favour.
